text.p: Mauritanian President Maaouya Ould Sid'Ahmed Taya has reshuffled his government, bringing in a new foreign minister and replacing his interior minister, officials said on Monday.

Sidi Ould Khalifa replaces Lemrabott Sidi Mahmoud Ould Cheikh Ahmed as foreign minister, Kabbah Ould Elewah takes over as minister of the interior and posts and telecommunications. Elewah was previously civil service minister.
There was no official explanation for the changes, implemented late on Sunday, but Khalifa was previously head of a commission dealing with public tenders.
In another switch, Trade, Craft and Tourism Minister Mohamed Mahmoud Ould Dahmane and Health and Social Affairs Minister Sow Abou Demba switched jobs.
Sghairy Ould Mbarack came into the government as education minister, replacing Baba Ould Sidi who switched to the civil service portfolio.
Taya and his ruling Democratic and Social Republican Party won a landslide victory in October's parliamentary election.
